name: SDN Host Node Activity
description: Host node_activity_read connector (typed contracts 1.0; M2 node-activity flow, GET /api/v1/node/activity). Method "activity" takes ONE $APR (SDS API Request: the routing decision from foundation/http-route route_node_activity) on "decision". When ROUTE is "activity" and STATUS is 0 it forwards the APR "limit" parameter (route-clamped; re-clamped here to [1, 256], default 50) to node_activity_read.activity (SDS $PIV hostcall: NodeActivityParams{LIMIT}; list "events" NodeActivityEvent, newest first), reads node.peerId (raw "value") and clock.now (TimeValue), and emits ONE $NEV (SDS Node Event: NODE_ID, GENERATED_AT_MS, EVENTS newest first) on "activity", plus the input $APR verbatim on "decision". Event kinds map peer_connected->PeerConnected, peer_disconnected->PeerDisconnected, pnm_publication->PublicationSent, record_stored->RecordsStored, grant_issued->GrantIssued; any other kind is Other with DETAIL "<kind>: <detail>". TOTAL_EVENTS and OLDEST_TIME_MS are 0 (unknown: the host does not report them). A decision refused upstream (STATUS set, e.g. 405) passes through untouched with NO hostcall and no body; a ROUTE this method does not own is answered STATUS 404 "no-route". A node_activity_read.activity failure answers the $APR with STATUS 503 "activity-unavailable" and the host message, no body. GENERATED_AT_MS is 0 when the host clock is unavailable. No JSON between modules: foundation/http-respond renders the $NEV. Capabilities: node_activity_read (Go node: the op prefix) and clock (built-in on the Go node; capability-gated on the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost). Anonymity: the mounted route stays anonymous:false (operator-gated at the host auth wall).

externalInterfaces.description: Policy-mediated read-only host node-activity log as SDS $PIV hostcalls (node_activity_read.activity -> list events, newest first, bounded by LIMIT); node.peerId (ungated) names the node.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $APR from foundation/http-route route_node_activity: ROUTE "activity" with PARAMETERS limit (GET/HEAD), or STATUS 405 for any other method.

inputPorts.description: One routing decision per HTTP exchange.

acceptedTypeSets.description: The input $APR verbatim when served or refused upstream; a copy with STATUS 404 "no-route" (route not owned) or 503 "activity-unavailable" (host failure).
$NEV (SDS Node Event) built from the host events, NODE_ID from node.peerId, GENERATED_AT_MS from clock.now.

outputPorts.description: The activity log read; absent when the decision is refused or the host read failed.

methods.description: Reads the node activity log through node_activity_read.activity (typed: SDS $PIV) when the $APR routes "activity", and emits the $NEV beside the decision. BATCHING: the "decision" port is single-stream BY CONTRACT and ENFORCED IN CODE: the compiled flow runtime drains a node queue port-blind (maxStreams is declarative only), so a surplus frame is refused with error code "batched-input-frames" naming the port and the count rather than silently discarded (graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames).
